correctness.all_other_original_jobs: Fresh independent Published references, no claim of old golden coverage
correctness.full_trace_audit_comparison: CPU reassembly of independent original task references; never feeds candidate state
correctness.serial_each_original_job: Frozen baseline prerequisites plus actual final-unit and every-warmup five-output checks

memcheck.failure: Block that method performance branches; preserve all planned arms; independently admitted other method may continue

R.unit: All five real jobs of the selected K under the selected boundary
R.rule: min(256,max(1,ceil(50/median(three actual SERIAL D1_GRAPH same-K same-boundary unit wall_ms))))

warmup.resident_alias: Distinct complete handle set; SERIAL has five handles, MIXED one; each exact prepared Graph/handle actually runs twice
warmup.entry_alias: Distinct factory identity; execute and destroy two complete factory units before formal
warmup.reused_alias_scope: Current quartet only; A and B never share resident handles

timing_contract.common_included: R complete equal-work units, each required cold reset/full solve/error read/five-output D2H/synchronization and actual split/dispatch to five job outputs
timing_contract.common_excluded: Read immutable files, shared Field create/upload, prerequisite checks, final CPU byte comparisons/hashes

RESIDENT_IO.included: Five original solver runs in job order or one prefixed mixed solver run, including five-output readback and split/dispatch
RESIDENT_IO.excluded: Geometry pack, solver create/geometry H2D/prepare, two alias warmups, solver destruction
RESIDENT_IO.geometry_before_timer: SERIAL keeps five original independent host jobs; MIXED prefix-packs exactly five jobs
RESIDENT_IO.handles_live_during_quartet: Only current A/B alias handle sets, maximum ten for SERIAL A/A

ENTRY_READY_HOST.start: Five immutable, already-loaded original host geometries, not a cached concatenated mixed job
ENTRY_READY_HOST.included: Necessary host preparation and MIXED prefix pack, create/alloc/geometry H2D/prepare, complete solve/readback, split/dispatch, destroy, repeated every work unit
ENTRY_READY_HOST.serial_lifecycle: In original job order, create/prepare/run/readback/destroy each original job; at most one solver live
ENTRY_READY_HOST.mixed_lifecycle: Pack all five original jobs, create/prepare one mixed solver, run/readback, split/dispatch, destroy
ENTRY_READY_HOST.geometry_reuse_API: Existing API has no set-geometry; solver/Graph factory must be repeated in each timed unit

timing_contract.final_unit_hash: Outside timer, compare all five dispatched job outputs for both SERIAL and MIXED; no output can be omitted
timing_contract.split_and_dispatch: Actually materialize/address each original job output with verified offsets, not count a predicted dispatch

geometry_contract.centers_and_endpoints: Copy original bytes in job order; no coordinate transformation or duplication
geometry_contract.CSR: Offset each job CSR by endpoint prefix; owners by node prefix; append one final total endpoint offset
geometry_contract.witness: Preserve original node-local rank and exact tie order; split must not convert to a global endpoint identity
geometry_contract.five_outputs: Split node-indexed arrays by node prefixes and original widths
geometry_contract.audit_trace: Compare center stripe then each endpoint round stripe and each node-bound stripe with corresponding original jobs

statistics.quartet_ratio: sqrt(a1*a2/(b1*b2)); A=SERIAL, B=MIXED for MIXED_BATCH; greater than one means mixed higher equal-work throughput
statistics.within_process: Median of two opposed ABBA/BAAB quartet ratios for each method/K/boundary
statistics.pooled: Median of all four direct quartet ratios from both processes
statistics.AA_required: For that method/K/boundary, both SERIAL and MIXED independent A/A in both processes
statistics.missing_or_failed: INCOMPLETE; retain all 256 plan rows and failures without replacement

resources.tracked_plus_graph_reservation_limit: min(2 GiB, initial free device bytes / 2), shared across all active aliases and Field
resources.memory_observations: Record cudaMemGetInfo plus tracked allocations and post-prepare solver info; sampled observations are not a device peak

admission_and_stopping.before_formal: Frozen identities plus each required method/style/K output equivalence, trace/audit, cold repeat, input/domain/capacity/lifecycle and memory checks
admission_and_stopping.prelaunch_capacity_rejection: Block affected method/style/K/boundary pairs and A/A; keep SKIPPED plan rows and continue independently admitted work
admission_and_stopping.actual_CUDA_or_output_error: A correctness/formal worker CUDA or output failure is fatal; stop further new GPU work and preserve partial wall separately from valid timing. Finite memcheck method-gate failures independently block only that method as specified above.
admission_and_stopping.time_or_output_budget: Stop, preserve missing arms as SKIPPED; no retries, replacements, additional arms or threshold changes
admission_and_stopping.repair_budget: No automatic source repair or new kernel revision is authorized by this plan; retain failures and report
admission_and_stopping.source_freeze_before_first_formal: Production binary, plan, input transform, worker, thresholds, and all four per-process R

expected_complete_counts.correctness_application_solves: Count actual independent correctness/reference solves separately; not benchmark samples
